I would say: "I didn't see you,
I was looking at the mirror.
Then I looked in the mirror—
He doesn't know I saw it.

fullTextZH: 我觉得中国人真的很棒。
fullTextEN: I think Chinese people are really great.

fullTextZH: 他们要来中国旅行以前，

fullTextEN: "Can your husband do the Asian squat?

fullTextZH: 要不然来中国旅行的时候，
可能外边很多厕所你不可以坐着，
fullTextEN: Maybe outside there are many toilets where you can't sit,
